name: A piece of the rock under Prosperity
note: EXTRACTED from docs/23-inventory-act1.md (Act II items) by tools/extract-content.mjs. Do not edit: change doc 23 and re-run. F3, from the seam. Shown to Winnie (WIN_F1) and laid down at F5. Errata 66 ruling A: shown to the character at C5 and kept; never consumed.

LOOK_AT.say: A piece of the rock from under Prosperity, about the size of a bishop's fist. It is very heavy for its size.
repeat: Yellow, where the lamp catches it. All autumn I have been told what gold looks like by men who have never seen any. This is what it looks like.
I have not told anyone yet. I have not decided whom to tell first, and I suspect the answer is a form.

LISTEN_TO.say: Nothing. It is too dense to ring.
repeat: Nothing. It has kept quiet for a very long time and sees no reason to start now.
